claims: Cryptocurrency trading is available 24/7 using a digital wallet or exchange.
Derivatives like futures are used to go long or short.
Going long is betting on rising prices.
Going short is betting on falling prices.
Derivatives allow trading volatility without owning the underlying asset.
Crypto.com is an option for buying or trading cryptocurrencies.
Interactive Brokers is an option for buying or trading cryptocurrencies via Paxos/Zerohash.
Gemini is an option for buying or trading cryptocurrencies.
HODL is buying and holding for the long term, regardless of volatility.
Arbitrage is buying on one exchange and selling on another for a higher price.
Scalping is making many small trades to profit from minor price changes.
Range Trading is identifying support and resistance levels to buy low and sell high.
